dataset.name: SketchAI 400-drawing comparative evaluation set
dataset.source: Google Quick, Draw! official bitmaps via quickdraw.js@1.0.6 (CC BY 4.0)
dataset.source_files: one NDJSON file per official class; first 100 records used by the 345-class model

selection.class_sampling: uniform without replacement from the 333 labels shared by both model profiles

heldout_split.row_rule: For each canonical class, NumPy default_rng(42).permutation(100); rows 90–99 of the resulting order are held out test rows. Matches the 345-model training split implementation.
heldout_split.independence_from_333_training: unknown; supplied model training provenance was not included

model_profiles.333: supplied GraphModel, current provisional app preprocessing

protocol.metrics: Top-k accuracy against the official class label; predictions from the app inference/preprocessing modules
uncertainties: The 333-class model source did not include training-data provenance, so overlap with this evaluation set cannot be ruled out.
The attached 333-class output-label map is used provisionally; its alignment with learned output neurons is unverified.
The supplied model training normalization was not documented; its app preprocessing remains provisional.
The 400 images are stratified over 40 randomly sampled categories, not a uniform sample over all Quick, Draw! examples.
